senses.gloss: (הֲ׳ Ar.) m. (חֲרַק) gap; בַּחֲרִיק־ in the gap caused by the absence of, in the place of.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 61a:4">Keth. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>עיילית לך איתתא בַחֲרִיקָאִי</he> I brought thee a wife in my place (a hand-maid for domestic labors otherwise resting on the wife).
<cite ref="Ketubot 105a:14">Ib. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>הבו לי … בחריקאי</he> get me a man to irrigate my fields in my stead.
<cite ref="Yoma 77a:5">Yoma 77ᵃ</cite> (in a passage omitted in later eds.) <he>בחֲרִיקֵיה</he> (Ms. M. <he>בהֲרִיקִי</he>) in his (my) place.
